title: Score keyed answers in code
statement: Score an answer that has a key in code and pick its feedback by lookup from the score and option chosen, so no model decides either.
detail: A Grade 5 course's corrective-feedback policy rules out a model grader on its auto-scored path. Feedback must be a deterministic function of the machine-scored response, the key and the option or span the learner chose, and no model call decides correctness, partial credit or which feedback string fires.

evidence.quote: Feedback selection must be a deterministic function of the machine-scored response (the key + the option/span the learner chose). No model call decides correctness, partial credit, or which feedback string fires on the scoring path.
Play needs no judge and replays … exactly.
// Play time: a line outside the accepted set is put to the judge, so a fair answer the author did not foresee counts.
